name: Aristotle South Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Socrates South power plant, New Albany
values.EndLocation: Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect, Liberty Township, Fairfield County
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)

researcher_notes: Will-Power Pipeline OH, LLC, a Williams company, filed a letter of notification with the Ohio Power Siting Board on June 23, 2025 (case 25-0561-GA-BLN) to build about 17.9 miles of 24-inch steel gas pipe. It runs from the planned Socrates South power plant in New Albany, Licking County, to an Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect in Liberty Township, Fairfield County. The filing notice is a PDF from a township mailing. No existing row in the tracker matches any Aristotle or Will-Power line. Data center tie: a June 2025 Pipeline and Gas Journal report says the Socrates South plant serves an adjacent Meta-affiliated data center and will get gas from two 24-inch pipelines to be filed separately. The Williams project page lists Aristotle South among the Socrates power solution facilities. No single page states outright that this pipeline serves the data center, so the tie is by way of the plant and the confidence is medium. Approval status of the pipeline case was not found, so status is proposed. Capacity, cost and start year were not found. The owner name is spelled in the ownership team's style; the entity is not in the owner list yet. No route was mapped. Two sibling lines, Aristotle Central and Aristotle North, are separate cases.
